quallaSearch.notes: Started with cleared Qualla published media and candidate metadata. Modern west/northeast selected exteriors require attribution and are excluded. Local public-domain candidates are historic premodern exteriors or wartime/unrelated scenes; metadata inspected, not used as controls for the current glass-dome building. Only then acquired two exact creator own-work CC0 modern west originals. Both native images and original-size facade/ceiling crops individually inspected.

originalReview.notes: Native original individually inspected, including original-size portico and facade crops. Daderot 2014 underside shows deep beams between front columns and rear glazing, crossing ties and ceiling coffers. Lenz 2019 whole west front controls retained column/pediment/tower/dome silhouette. Creator own-work CC0 primary revisions, no-attribution/no-restrictions metadata and native SHA-1/SHA-256 verified. Exact member sections, depths and obscured side/east details remain estimates.
